action_scope: Recommendation only for next changed candidate; no current gate rerun/job/source changes.

existing_hooks.faulthandler: No faulthandler/dump_traceback hook found in current src/tests/scripts.

existing_hooks.worker_boundary: parallel_unittests._spawn starts separate Python -m literate_ai.parallel_unittest_worker per module; worker scratch TMPDIR/OBJ_DIR/BUILD_DIR/config/state reset, evidence run/parent env removed. Parent watchdog is not inherited into an exec-created Python worker.

minimal_stack_design.owner: A small test-only stdlib helper used only by AuthoredNativeCompletionTests, AuthoredReopenedNativeExecutionTests and AuthoredOwningAdmissionTests, armed at case setUp before fixture construction, disarmed with original cleanup. No generic installed product profiling framework.
minimal_stack_design.file_owner: CI precreates explicit absolute fresh per-job root such as workspace/_build/evidence/native-stacks. Pass only dedicated test-owned path variable; helper uses that explicit root, exclusive private binary files, short stable test-id hash/module-id/PID names. Do not derive artifact root from worker TMPDIR/OBJ_DIR/BUILD_DIR or native fixture roots.
minimal_stack_design.why_outside: Those worker scratch locations contain source/currentness/output namespaces; writing diagnostics there can itself invalidate native closure. Artifact root must be outside every observed source/output/native scratch and retain its own original directory ownership.
minimal_stack_design.timer: One faulthandler.dump_traceback_later(300,repeat=False,file=held_binary_fd,exit=False) per selected case. Timer changes no original deadline, exception or result. Cancel in finally BEFORE closing FD; no stderr fallback. Keep file reference/FD alive; do not rotate or rebind it while armed.
minimal_stack_design.bounds: One-shot per finite selected case (3+4+4cases in named modules), with Python3.11/3.14 documented finite thread/frame/string output bounds. This is structural boundedness, not an independently enforced arbitrary64KiB file cap. Do not use unbounded repeat=True, resource-limit signals or blocked bounded pipes.
minimal_stack_design.overhead: C watchdog timer, no Python sampling loop, clock polling or probes inside original hot guards. No code line source, locals, environment, argv, prompts, provider routes or credential dump. Use common3.11/3.14 parameters only; no3.15-only max_threads argument. Do not enable C-stack dumping, which can be slow.
minimal_stack_design.phase_context: Header contains only public static case/module label and process ID. Existing module-timing plus captured stack function/line identifies current layer. If more phase labels are needed, add finite test-boundary markers outside product guard callbacks, never repeated native probes or currentness changes.
minimal_stack_design.diagnostic_failure: Diagnostic setup/cancel/write errors must not mask or convert original test outcomes; unavailable/incomplete stack is explicitly unknown evidence. CI artifact-root setup can fail its own diagnostic preparation step. No test skip or assumed pass because sample absent.
minimal_stack_design.single_watchdog_ownership: faulthandler timer is process-global and repeated arming replaces prior timer. Keep helper non-nested and limited to these case owners; no competing timers. Exclude diagnostic cleanup from original source/native artifact owners.
minimal_stack_design.parent_vs_inner: Primary hook belongs INSIDE actual module test worker through test class/context. Parent-only hook would miss worker hot stacks and mostly show waiting scheduler. Add separate test-owned parent hook only if future evidence implicates parent; repository test adapter could scope it without altering original argv/protocol, but no such hook needed by current measured evidence. Do not inject startup hooks/sitecustomize/PYTHONFAULTHANDLER into reviewed toolchain or observed source. If worker stack waits on another Python child, first identify that original call path; do not wrap/change executable identity to force child profiling.

windows_control_probe.original_owner: remote_cleanup._control original open check, using metadata node/native, existing os.fstat opened, existing _descriptor_identity, existing signatures.
windows_control_probe.recommendation: Failure-only bounded note on exact original exception at original failed guard. Preserve original shortcircuit and call count: native mismatch branch must not evaluate signatures originally skipped; when native agrees evaluate each original signature exactly once, preserve equality check.
report_fields: original expected and observed native identity primitive fields
precomputed named/fd values and mismatch field names
windows_control_probe.no_extra_observations: No additional lstat/fstat/open/read/hash/native identity query, currentness/callback, clock or content read. Do not add observer callbacks, serialize arbitrary metadata projections or inspect traceback locals.
windows_control_probe.error_preservation: Keep original RemoteCleanupError type/message/code/refusal and original control/descriptor cleanup; guarded add_note cannot mask original exception. No catch-and-return, new skip, repeatedprobe, relaxed metadata signature or ctime removal.
windows_control_probe.serialization: Only bounded exact primitive tuples/ints and fixed labels, no private path/credential/env/payload strings. Do not canonical-identity hash native unsigned IDs; they may exceed signed64 schema range. Note formatting failure leaves original error unchanged.
windows_control_probe.preflight_comparison: A separate owned native API sample can show generic API clock/identity compatibility but cannot prove original failing control values or predicate. It adds different opens/state. Prefer exact original guard note; do not weaken production based solely on standalone preflight.

official_docs.relevant_contract: Delayed traceback uses watchdog thread; defaultFalse repeat/exit, repeated call replaces timer; retain FD until dump/cancel. Traceback includes filename/function/line, not locals/source, finite100thread/100frame/500character-string format.

limits: No code, workflow, test, job, external post, API-model request, dispatch or source mutation.
No future stack collection has happened. One-shot snapshot localizes a sampled path; it is not a statistical profile or proof of dominant cost.
No deadline/assertion/result/currentness/custody permission or qualification semantics changed by this design.
